summary: After the broker drops the socket, nothing of the last connection carries over: the first tk after the reconnect has no feed time, and the frame does not take the last connection's (it falls back to the receipt time).

notes: Partial updates overlay within a connection only: docs/port/market-data-frames.md, Partial-update feeds; lead correction 2026-11-09, .lane/107/decisions.md: a field a partial packet omits is unchanged, not unknown. Both sides drop their snapshots on a new connection.

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft unchanged as ltt: epoch seconds as a string, and on the first tk of the new connection, which has no ft, an empty string (its snapshot was cleared). The protocol's WebSocket timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the time in ms as a number, and for a packet without one the time it made the tick.

AliceBlue's tick carries last_quantity (ltq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent (lost data, lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop sends it.
